about: The persona fill rule (mascot_core::persona::fill). One shared set of cases: the Rust unit test, the Personality page's fill.js and agent/test/unit/persona_fill.test.ts must all produce `out`. `you` / `catchphrase` null = unset.

cases.name: you unset mid text
cases.text: Morning, {you}. I saved you the good side of the desk.
cases.out: Morning. I saved you the good side of the desk.

cases.name: you unset without a comma drops its space
you unset keeps the comma after it
catchphrase after a sentence is capitalised, its dot kept
cases.text: Fixed. It was the cache, like I said an hour ago. {catchphrase}.
cases.out: Fixed. It was the cache, like I said an hour ago. Told you so.

cases.name: catchphrase mid sentence stays lowercase
cases.text: All done, and {catchphrase} The tests are green.
cases.out: All done, and all cozy! The tests are green.

cases.name: no second dot after a catchphrase that ends in punctuation
after a question mark
cases.out: Hi, Sam! New branch? Ooh, what's this?

cases.name: catchphrase unset: token, dot and space go
a filled value is not scanned again
